Ashara and Rashid are already through the garden doors, their voices lost beyond the cold breath of the plateau. The opportunity passes without asking them to turn back.

In the common room, cards snap against the study table near the fire. Thessaly has paused beside the players, watching their hands with reserved scrutiny. The dining hall grows quieter as the servers clear the last glasses.
